cause: Model binding: a draft's catalogue comes from fetchGlobalOmpModelSnapshot (chat-sessions.ts:281-297), which probes the first non-archived session. That probe's selectedModelId is the bare claude-4.6-opus-high that OMP get_state reports, while get_available_models lists it as cursor/claude-4.6-opus-high, so modelPickerGroupFromSnapshot (chat-sessions-map.ts:499-513) finds no row and publishes no selected; applyDraftModelChoice (chat-sessions.ts:154-179) then cannot resolve a provider, keeps OMP's default, and only logs it.

Error rendering: emitEntryUpdate (chat-sessions.ts:881-908) renders entry text or a tool card, so an error-terminated assistant message with empty content renders nothing and the turn reads as a normal completion.
cursorReference: reference-cursor-empty-draft.ax.txt/.png - the running Cursor Agents window in the same empty-draft state: composer holds Add agents, context, tools / High / Start voice input and no model pill; right pane is splitter 'Resize panel' -> Panel editor-panel-group -> tab group Tabs with a real instance tab, combo box 'Open new tab menu', Enter Full Screen, Hide Apps. The pill is therefore Caret's own surface, and the violated rule is the project's own §11 gate 4 (honest states), not parity.
fixDirection: Extension-side only (no desktop patch, no gulp rebuild; verify with bun run package:mac + relaunch): resolve a model pick by exact catalogue id and then by unique provider-qualified suffix so the published selected row and the bound model cannot disagree, fall back to displaying the host's current model when nothing resolves, and map an error-terminated assistant message to a visible error plus the failed session state. Confirm OMP's real id shapes before writing the resolution rule.

labelProbe.conclusion: the catalogue row exists and Caret publishes it as selected; the workbench hands the same id and name back at creation, yet draws 'DeepSeek V4.1 Flash'. The mismatch is in the workbench's session-option presentation (a persisted option label surviving the provider's published selected), so the fix is desktop-side: refresh the control's label or stop offering a model control that is not the one that runs (Cursor's Agents composer has no model pill at all).

composerModelControl.whatItIs: The workbench's own language-model picker, fed by the user's installed providers (list: Auto, openrouter | Claude Opus 4.6 1M, cursor | DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, opencode-go [marked Current model] | DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Command Code), commandcode | Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor, opencode-go).
composerModelControl.wired: ompModelForPickedLanguageModel resolves the attached model against OMP's catalogue; the participant handler (the path a submitted prompt takes) calls applyRequestedModel before runTurn, applies it when OMP runs that model, and writes an honest line when it does not. Live log: 'Caret participant turn for session faed46de-...' then 'Caret did not apply the composer's model claude-4.6-opus-high: it is not in OMP's catalogue.'
composerModelControl.finding: The model attached to the request is claude-4.6-opus-high, what Caret published from OMP's get_state, while the pill and the picker's Current model marker both say DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. The user's pick never reaches the request and the marker is stale, so the turn kept running the rate-limited cursor/claude-4.6-opus-high and a working model cannot be chosen from this window.
options: make the control reflect and honour the provider's published selection
stop presenting a model control whose pick has no effect (Cursor's Agents composer has no model pill)
